title: Clock
description: Displays the current time and date in a premium look.

layout.title: Look
layout.description: How the clock looks. Minimal shows neither seconds nor date, Weekday first has its own date.

size.title: Size
size.description: How large the clock is. Scales the time, date, timezone and dial together; the header keeps its size.

format.title: Time format
format.description: 12-hour (AM/PM) or 24-hour clock. Follow the mirror uses the mirror's own setting.

show_seconds.title: Show seconds
show_seconds.description: Display active ticking seconds beside the hour and minutes.

date_format.title: Date format
date_format.description: Localized date format style (full, long, medium, short) or a custom pattern.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Show the time in another time zone (e.g. America/New_York). Blank follows the mirror.

timezone_display.title: Show time zone
timezone_display.description: Show which time zone the clock is in, below the date.
